output.title: Ripple wins final US approval for national trust bank
output.summary: The approval clears the way for Ripple to manage reserves backing its RLUSD stablecoin and provide digital asset custody.

output.title: US OCC calls on community banks to become payment stablecoin issuers
output.summary: The announcement followed the banking regulator finalizing its rules for the GENIUS Act, a stablecoin law to be implemented in January

output.title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
output.summary: The new index tracks rental prices for five Nvidia GPUs, offering leveraged trading and potential hedging against fluctuations in AI computing costs.
